name: Anytime Fitness
royaltyPercent: $842/mo Monthly Fee (may convert to up to 8% of Gross Revenue)
description: Anytime Fitness is a 24-hour fitness center franchise headquartered in Woodbury, Minnesota, offering members convenient access to cardio and strength equipment, personal training, group training, nutrition coaching, and recovery services under the Anytime Fitness brand. Franchisees operate 4,000 to 7,000 square-foot centers in a protected territory of up to a 3-mile radius, with the system totaling 2,282 outlets at year-end 2025 across all 50 states. The 2026 FDD's Item 19 reports average 2025 revenue of $446,814 across 1,683 franchised centers using AF Coaching, with a fixed-fee structure of $842 monthly fee plus $900 monthly advertising and $799 monthly technology fees.
territoryDescription: Protected (not exclusive): circle around the center with radius up to 3 miles and population up to 30,000. Protected territories may overlap; the franchisor may operate, franchise, or license competing outlets elsewhere, and the franchisee may face competition from other franchisees, company outlets, or other channels/brands the franchisor controls.
item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 Table No. 1 (pp.60-61): 2,282 total outlets as of 12/31/2025 (2,271 franchised + 11 company-owned). The 15 pins below are FEATURED locations - real Exhibit C-1 franchisee cities geocoded for this report - not a complete map of all outlets.
risk_score_method: base 15 +6 litigation (5 Item-3 matters) +10 capital intensity (ceiling $905,482) +6 fixed fee load ($2,541/mo) +4 non-exclusive territory +4 closure rate (~1.8%) +2 renewal friction (30 non-renewals in 2025) +3 system contraction (net -47 franchised, 2023-2025) -6 Item 19 strength (n=1,683, 74% coverage) -2 audited financials = 42/100

risk_factors.detail: Investment range tops $905,482 with a $42,500 nonrefundable initial franchise fee and no franchisor financing (FDD Item 7, p.19).
$842/mo Monthly Fee + $900/mo advertising + $799/mo technology = $2,541/mo before local marketing spend (FDD Item 6, pp.11-12).
Three Spain (Anytime Fitness Iberia) franchisee disputes - two pending, one dismissed and on appeal - plus two settled Bar Method affiliate regulatory matters (FDD Item 3, pp.7-8).
Protected circle only - up to 3 miles, 30,000 population; protected territories may overlap and competition from other franchisees or franchisor channels is permitted (FDD Item 12, pp.44-45).
39 terminations and 3 other closures in 2025 - about 1.8% of the franchised base - plus 30 non-renewals (FDD Item 20, Table 3, p.66).
Franchised count fell by 47 net outlets from 2023 to 2025, from 2,318 to 2,271 (FDD Item 20, Table 1, pp.60-61).
Renewal requires a new (possibly materially different) agreement, compliance with then-current standards, a general release, and a $7,500 renewal fee (FDD Item 17, p.51).
Item 19 covers 1,683 franchised centers - 74% of the system - with average total revenue of $446,814 and disclosed company-owned EBITDA of $149,620 at a 28.67% margin (FDD Item 19, pp.54-59).
Audited financial statements of affiliate SEB Franchising Guarantor LLC are attached at Exhibit D (FDD Item 21, p.69).
